selection.rule: First existing state that participates in the separately selected SANT--SSTC exchange pilot, at the shallowest complete hydrography support and its August 2018 monthly sample.

uncertainty.reason: one ORAS5 ensemble member and four monthly snapshots; distribution spread is not measurement or model uncertainty

boundary_context.reason: The exchange pilot uses an open 16-face boundary segment and all-depth transport anatomy. It is not a closed SANT volume, a 0-200 m interior measurement, or a compatible state-budget term.

unknowns.reason: No admitted vertical velocity, diapycnal flux, mixing, entrainment, or closed compatible budget.
No pre-registered interior seeds, destinations, trajectory control, or tracer pathway is admitted.
No closed control-volume geometry and matched boundary/surface/storage terms are admitted.
Temperature alone cannot define a water-mass class change; salinity, density, and class-volume flux are unavailable.
The admitted 2026 surface heatwave route is spatially and temporally incompatible with this 2018 Drake account.

boundary: This ledger indexes one declared reference state, depth support, and month. It reports one temperature distribution and named absences; it does not infer a uniform state interior, a water mass, a pathway, mixing, convergence, heat content, transport, causal mechanism, or budget closure.
